subject: CPPB Domain III: Sourcing & Supplier Selection

questions.q: During an RFP discussion phase, a buyer tells Vendor B about a highly innovative, proprietary scheduling feature proposed by Vendor A, and asks Vendor B to include a similar feature in their BAFO. This unethical violation is known as:
questions.explain: Technical Transfusion (or leveling) occurs when government personnel disclose one vendor's technical or innovative ideas to another vendor, effectively giving away intellectual property to generate better BAFOs. It is highly unethical and illegal.

questions.q: Which of the following statements made by a procurement officer during an RFP negotiation represents an unethical/illegal practice known as 'Auctioning'?
options: Your proposed price exceeds our independent cost estimate by 20%.
We need you to rethink your pricing on line items 4 and 5.
Vendor C just offered $45,000 for this work. If you bid $44,000, the contract is yours.
questions.explain: Auctioning occurs when a buyer reveals a competitor's exact price to another vendor to force them to beat it. In sealed proposal processes, competing prices must be kept confidential during negotiations.
